recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E：淋巴結整體結構保留，被膜與竇下方可見一個濾泡，其生發中心被淡染的大細胞群部分取代，周圍仍有深色小淋巴球構成的外套區；大細胞聚集侷限於濾泡內而非瀰漫破壞結構，是 germinotropic LPD 的低倍線索。
features: Preserved lymph node architecture with capsule and patent subcapsular region
Follicle whose germinal center is partially replaced by aggregates of large pale cells
Rim of dark small lymphocytes (mantle zone) around the involved follicle
Paracortex with prominent high endothelial venules
No diffuse effacement or geographic necrosis at this magnification
describe_en: Lymph node at low power shows a preserved architecture with an intact capsule. A follicle beneath the capsule contains a germinal center that is partially replaced by aggregates of large pale-staining cells, surrounded by a rim of dark small mantle zone lymphocytes, while the adjacent paracortex shows prominent high endothelial venules. There is no diffuse effacement or necrosis. The germinal-center-restricted clusters of large cells, confirmed as HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER positive plasmablasts on ancillary studies, are consistent with HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarization with tingible body macrophages and a mix of centroblasts and centrocytes, and lack HHV8/EBV-positive plasmablast clusters.
MCD shows regressed, hyalinized germinal centers with expanded onion-skin mantle zones and scattered single plasmablasts rather than germinal-center aggregates.
FL shows crowded back-to-back monotonous follicles lacking mantle zones and polarity, with BCL2+ germinal-center B cells rather than CD20-negative plasmablasts.
